$schema-note: The server's own words: Discord bot replies and embeds (discord.*), push notifications (push.event.*), email (mail.*) and the app sign-in page (confirm.*). Same grammar as en.json; only the Go target (api/internal/copygen) reads this file. A word the site or an app also shows lives in en.json or shared.json, and the server reads that key.
